name: Human-Centric Evaluation (HCE)
description: HCE is a subjective evaluation framework for foundation models focusing on problem-solving ability, information quality, and interaction experience. It includes a participant-driven dataset capturing diverse user feedback across multiple disciplines to assess authentic human experiences with models.
reputation: A new subjective evaluation framework from a recent paper, with early-stage adoption rather than established community-wide use.
notes: Includes a large-scale subjective dataset with over 540 participant-driven evaluations; aims to standardize and automate subjective assessments.
